description: The figure contains two side-by-side vertical bar charts illustrating Fleiss’ Kappa values across different ambiguity-related category levels. In both panels, the horizontal axis contains the categories and the vertical axis is labeled “Fleiss Kappa” on a linear scale starting at 0 and extending to just under 1, with visible tick labels at approximately 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, and 0.8. In the left panel, the x-axis shows four numeric category labels in increasing order (0.0, 0.47, 0.82, 0.94), and each category has a single solid bar in a blue palette; the bars are annotated with their values: 0.0 has a dark blue bar at about 0.88, 0.47 has a medium blue bar at about 0.46, 0.82 has a light blue short bar at about 0.03, and 0.94 has a lighter blue bar at about 0.24. In the right panel, the x-axis is labeled “Max Ambiguity” and shows three integer categories in increasing order (1, 2, 3), each with a single blue bar annotated with its value: category 1 has a dark blue bar at about 0.89, category 2 has a medium blue bar at about 0.46, and category 3 has a lighter blue bar at about 0.23. No legend is shown, there is no stacking or grouping within categories beyond the single bars, and the bars appear ordered by the natural ascending order of the x-axis labels rather than by bar height; the primary visual emphasis comes from the numeric value labels placed above each bar.
